QuestInfo.name: A God Among Horses
QuestInfo.0: Princess Sakuno has contacted you. What could it be?
QuestInfo.1: Princess Sakuno has requested your presence in Momijigaoka.
QuestInfo.2: The princess complimented your abilities as a warrior and granted you a harness that was used by the former Lord Nobukageh. This new harness fits Onikageh perfectly. He seems to like it!
